verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Atlassian publishes an official MCP server repository (atlassian/atlassian-mcp-server), so an agent can connect to Jira through a first-party MCP server. The evidence is a single probe finding with no detail on setup, available tools, or auth. Missing for 10: documentation of supported Jira tools/operations, authentication and connection setup details, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connectivity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
